prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, but underestimated gains for winning tests in sign-in reorders, home notifications, adoption new flows, and choose path layouts.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder), home notifications (home, notification), adoption new flows (adoption, new_flow), and choose path layouts (choose_path, layout) proved helpful across multiple winning tests.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), finish hints (finish, hint), finish incentives (finish, incentive), home hints (home, hint), and sign-in notifications (sign_in, notification) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) and finish redesigns (finish, redesign) resulted in negative impacts or guardrail rollbacks across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once (including adoption incentive, adoption wait_info, choose_path hint/incentive/new_flow, home new_flow, and sign_in new_flow), requiring at least 2 tests to state a pattern.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, new_flow] Choose Path Interactive Choice Flow: Replace path option cards with an interactive preview flow that displays animated companion behavior previews for each path option. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s despite 78.5% conversion, showing user hesitation; past lessons highlight choose path layout/flow changes as effective.)
1: [sign_in, layout] Sign In Spotlight Layout Refresh: Redesign the sign-in screen using a spotlight layout to focus attention on quick authentication actions. (why: Sign-in mean duration is 567s and support reported sign-in stalls; layout improvements help focus user attention.)
2: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Two Column Layout: Rebuild the pet selection screen into a two-column layout comparing pet appearance and pet personality traits side-by-side. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 75.7% with mean duration of 1017s; side-by-side evaluation streamlines selection.)
3: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Desktop Notification Alert: Display a system notification toggle and confirmation banner on the waiting screen to alert users on desktop when pet setup finishes. (why: Home step mean time is 2336s as users leave the app during generation; home notifications were highlighted as a winning pattern in past lessons.)
4: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Story Scroll Layout: Reorganize the adoption certificate screen into a story scroll layout that guides users through adoption summary details. (why: Adoption step drops conversion to 75.7%; clear layout structure during adoption confirmation helps push users forward.)
5: [adoption, new_flow] Pick Friend Interactive Animation Flow: Introduce an interactive animation flow on the pet selection screen allowing users to trigger live animations of pet reactions. (why: Adoption has high friction (1017s mean time); past lessons noted adoption new flows as strong performers.)
6: [adoption, new_screen] New Pet Trait Preview Screen: Insert a dedicated companion trait preview screen before custom photo upload to show how traits will be mapped onto the pet. (why: Support mails reported custom pet failures and incorrect rendering (3 emails); clarifying pet traits beforehand sets proper expectations.)
7: [adoption, layout] Upload Photos Checklist Layout: Update photo upload layout to a checklist structure outlining recommended photo lighting, angle, and clarity steps. (why: Support received 3 complaints regarding failed or misbehaved custom pets; structured checklist format improves upload quality.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Card Layout Refresh: Refresh the initial story intro screen using a clean card layout highlighting core pet interaction features. (why: Choose path mean duration is 514s; choose path layout changes have consistently proven successful in past iterations.)
9: [home, new_flow] Waiting Screen Live Progress Flow: Add an interactive stage progress component to the waiting screen that updates dynamically as desktop assets initialize. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s; visual stage progress keeps users informed while the app generates pet assets.)
